decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the established data integration offer, has its own page and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open while it earns steady demand.
Building digital twins remain an uncertain but growing field tied to public-sector demand, and holding this low-visibility, low-cost option one more year keeps upside for little cost.
The delegation service overlaps with the identity service and could be merged into E later, but its cost is low and its value as part of the security stack has not yet been disproven.
The identity service was actively launched, fits the core GIS platform business, and shows commitment, so it is worth further investment rather than abandonment.
The consulting workshop is newly launched, has its own page, builds on existing consulting skills and costs almost nothing to offer, so it is too early to judge its value.
